newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy metalworkers say will hold strike this week.
newsitem.headline: Italy metalworkers say will hold strike this week.

text.p: Unions representing Italy's engineers and metalworkers said they planned to stage a three-hour strike sometime this week while continuing talks with employers over a pay dispute.
The FIOM, FIM, ULIM unions issued a statement announcing the strike plans after meeting the director general of employers' group Federmeccanica, Michele Figurati, for a second straight day of talks.
The statement said the three-hour strike would take place by Friday, but it did not say when exactly it would be held. It also confirmed more talks would be held on Thursday.
Talks resumed on Monday for the first time in more than a month. The dispute has already seen three one-day strikes since it began last June which the sector's two-year contract agreement expired.
